body:
From Lane A mobile audit of #264/#265 (custom workout authoring). Non-blocking; PROD flag-off behavior is verified correct.

`src/screens/coach/__tests__/customExerciseFlag.test.tsx:144-147,159` — the flag-OFF pin (`expect(queryByLabelText('Author your own move')).toBeNull()`) failed once on a full parallel run (27/28), passed on re-run, and passes 3/3 in isolation and under `--runInBand`. Non-deterministic timing, not a flag-off defect.

Cause: `loadScreen()` re-requires the module-cached screen without `jest.resetModules()`, while the file mutates process-global `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_CUSTOM_EXERCISE`; the flag-ON test's deferred async state can bleed across the shared registry under worker load.

Fix (test hygiene only, no prod change): add `jest.resetModules()` + `jest.isolateModules` around `loadScreen` in `beforeEach`, set env deterministically per-test, `await waitFor`/flush microtasks between ON/OFF cases. Lowest-risk alternative: split ON and OFF into two files, or pin worker count for this suite.

Origin: lane_a_mobile_audit.md finding 1.
title: [P3] customExerciseFlag flag-OFF test flaky under parallel jest (test hygiene, prod correct)
